raw.headline: Prioritize Usability: it has the most complaints and severity among the four named areas, led by the post-update layout regression.
raw.memo_markdown:
## Recommendation
Prioritize Usability. Among the four named areas it has the most complaints ({{C051}}) and the largest severity sum ({{C052}}), with mean severity {{C053}} and a complaint share of {{C054}}. Start with the post-update layout regression in `usability/ui_layout`, then reduce ad interruptions and fix general usability bugs in `usability/ads` and `usability/general`.

## Evidence
`usability/ui_layout` ranks third in the baseline with {{C011}} complaints and a severity sum of {{C012}}. Reviews such as `e16a4550-43e7-4ae1-b538-a65cc652c31b` and `9e5f9745-f8be-48d3-b9de-4d118507d94a` describe inability to repeat or go back within tracks after the update, and `45c561b9-cc47-4d80-95d3-f0d20bc84af3` says the update made the app useless.

`usability/general` adds {{C016}} complaints and `usability/ads` adds {{C026}}. Review `cf6166ae-d71a-4839-9add-088645ad3b78` reports ads replacing songs, and `9c9757da-6b99-4c95-a0e7-0661ee858027` reports a broken music adjustment feature. `usability/queue_playlist` adds {{C031}} complaints about playback control frustration.

## Alternatives considered
Billing/support has {{C063}} complaints, a severity sum of {{C064}} and mean severity {{C065}}. Most of that comes from `billing/subscription_entitlement` ({{C006}} complaints, ranked second overall), where review `d146397f-4a94-4980-be00-ae9212eca3a7` describes features locked behind premium. This is a real concern, but it is concentrated in one issue and is smaller than Usability as an area.

Playback has {{C059}} complaints and a severity sum of {{C060}}, with mean severity {{C061}}. Its issues are small: `playback/general` has {{C021}} complaints at mean severity {{C023}}, and review text points to stalling and failed playback with external assistants.

Access has only {{C067}} complaints, though its mean severity is {{C069}}. `access/account_recovery` has {{C041}} complaint. This is a narrow problem and does not justify broad effort.

Outside the four areas there are {{C055}} complaints, a share of {{C058}}. Most of that sits in `other/general`, which is generic negative feedback with {{C001}} complaints and no specific product target, and in `catalog/lyrics`. Neither maps to one of the four areas, so I excluded them from the choice.

## Limitations
Reviews are self-selected public app-store text, not a random sample. Cancellation language is stated intent, not observed churn; there are {{C074}} cancellation intent records. No revenue, churn, or causal effects are estimated here. Overall there are {{C071}} completed records and {{C072}} complaint or cancellation records. {{C073}} records remain unresolved, pending, or quarantined, so these counts could change once they are resolved.
